items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1964-04-25
items.q: Michelle something, funny name, the piano player. He got so interested up there that... Hardy would play the instrument when he's talking to me.

ctx.x: Did you teach them much when you went up there? Huh? Did you... Could you teach them much when you went up there by doing? No. No. No, I didn't.

I must admit that. No, I didn't. Of course, I spoke plenty about music and watching and understood them, you understand? And there was one... one fellow I can't... Michelle something, funny name, the piano player. He got so interested up there that... Hardy would play the instrument when he's talking to me. He said, talk to me while they're playing. If he's talking to me. Because I didn't know what minute I was going to jump, you know. I had to come back here. Too much work here. I played put in there every night…
